items.text: Multiple visits to the White House this week to celebrate the @POTUS signing two much needed initiatives! One will ensure that 5M additional Americans will receive health care coverage - this is essential on the pathway to universal health care. https://t.co/nICiEE9LJJ

Looking to get healthcare at an affordable rate? Reliable healthcare coverage is available NOW at https://t.co/25KPvJgrVX. You have until December 15 to enroll in a plan that starts at the beginning of 2023.
Call me radical, but no one should have to die because they can’t afford access to health care or life-saving treatment. We need Medicare for All.
Medicare for All isn’t radical. What’s radical is letting people die because they can’t afford access to health care or lifesaving treatment.
Everyone deserves to have access to health care and should not have to choose between medical treatment and putting food on the table. We need #MedicareForAll.

Auto insurance companies shouldn’t be able to use your job, credit score, or zip code to decide your rate. @RepBonnie and I are reintroducing the PAID Act to end these racist, discriminatory practices and ensure rates are based on driving ability. Let’s break the cycle of poverty. https://t.co/8VRjx5iBIL

Your marriage status, education level, credit score, income, occupation, zip code, and home ownership status have nothing to do with your driving ability, so why are they used to determine your auto insurance rates? That's why we reintroduced the PAID Act. https://t.co/Hrz4iPZcGw

Let's be clear: gender-affirming health care for transgender young people is suicide prevention. The Court needs to stop infringing on our freedoms, greenlighting discrimination, and trying to advance their own right-wing political agenda.
Trump's budget betrayal invests in the Pentagon war machine, but cuts Medicaid and food assistance for our families. It will cause 14 million Americans to lose their health care.

It's disgusting that our elected officials continue to reject the idea of making sure no one goes hungry or dies from a lack of health care coverage, but always invest trillions of dollars in death and destruction.
